verdicts.question: Are there any obstacles at the site that could hinder material lifting?
verdicts.photo_observation: Pages 8–9 show the material delivery route uses a neighbour's staircase-ladder with a width of only 700mm (page 9, 'Staircase Details'). This narrow staircase is the sole lifting route for PV modules (620Wp Adani panels, ~32kg each, 2382mm x 1133mm). Electrical Q14 also acknowledges 'limited space of the staircase' as a challenge. While designer answered 'No' for obstacles, the visual evidence shows a 700mm-wide narrow staircase that presents a real physical constraint for large panel handling.
verdicts.rationale: Photos on pages 8–9 show a narrow 700mm staircase via neighbour's house as the only lifting route. This is physically challenging for 2382mm-long panels (panel length exceeds staircase width by 3.4x). Designer's 'No' answer appears inconsistent with the staircase constraint explicitly noted in electrical Q14. Recommend manual review of lifting feasibility.
